name: Astral Stranger
source:
Northeastern prefecture. Autumn.
Even in this region, summers are blistering hot.
A transfer student with stark white hair is greeted with laughter.
Who is this "astral stranger"...?

The story of a day shared by two protagonists.
An original teen suspense novel.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE090681.html]DLsite English[/url]]
